# Contract: characters (v1.14)

Producer: ENV C (generated humanoids + animations). Consumer: ENV A (NPC/crew prefabs).
Until delivered, ENV A uses capsule placeholders with the same node names.

## Rig
* One shared humanoid skeleton `rig_humanoid` (generated by `tools/blender/characters/rig.py`),
  height 1.78 m (default), Y-up, facing −Z, root at the feet. Bones (exact names):
  `root, hips, spine, chest, neck, head, clavicle.L/R, upper_arm.L/R, forearm.L/R, hand.L/R,
  thigh.L/R, shin.L/R, foot.L/R, toe.L/R` plus finger chains `thumb|index|middle|ring|pinky_0[1-3].L/R`.
* Body variants are produced by scaling bones within ±6% height and through shape keys
  (build, gender, age); all of them share the skeleton so animations retarget 1:1.

## Visual scene shape (`world/characters/<id>/<id>.tscn`)
```
<Root> Node3D
├── Skeleton3D (rig_humanoid) with MeshInstance3D parts (body, head, outfit, gear)
├── AnimationPlayer with library "humanoid" (names below)
├── Marker attachments as BoneAttachment3D: `HandR` (weapon), `HandL`, `Head` (mask/hat), `Back` (bag),
│   `Hip` (pager/radio)
└── Hitbox proxies are NOT here (ENV A builds hitboxes from bone names)
```
Specials add: Wrecker `Faceplate`, `Visor` MeshInstance3D nodes (A hides them on break) and
`HeadArmored` variants; Phantom `Goggles` with emission; Bulwark `Shield` scene (separate, with
`Collision`); Longshot `LaserOrigin`.

## Animation names (library "humanoid"), in-place, 30 fps, loops marked *
`idle*, idle_alert*, walk*, run*, sprint*, crouch_idle*, crouch_walk*, strafe_l*, strafe_r*,
walk_back*, turn_l, turn_r, aim_rifle*, aim_pistol*, fire_rifle, fire_pistol, reload_rifle,
reload_pistol, melee, death_front, death_back, hit_react, surrender, kneel_cuffed*, hands_up*,
cower*, lie_down*, tied*, flee*, phone_call*, radio_call, pager_answer*, investigate_look*,
smoke*, lean_wall*, sit_chair*, desk_type*, browse*, downed*, tased*, kick_charge, kick_hit,
shield_walk*, shield_bang, heal_ally, dozer_walk*, climb_ladder*, carry_bag_walk*, throw_bag,
interact_low*, interact_mid*, interact_high*, drill_place`
First-person viewmodel arms: separate rig `rig_arms` (C) plus animation sets per `WeaponDef.anim_set`
(B requests new sets via the lead).

## v1.1 clarifications (QD-2, D-029)
* Producer: **ENV D** (D-027), no longer ENV C.
* Exact node paths in `world/characters/<id>/<id>.tscn`: `<Root>/Skeleton3D` (node name literally
  `Skeleton3D`), `<Root>/AnimationPlayer`, and BoneAttachment3D nodes `HandR`, `HandL`, `Head`, `Back`, `Hip` as
  children of `Skeleton3D`. Clips are played as `"humanoid/<clip>"`. The library comes from a single shared
  `char_anim_humanoid` glb, converted to an AnimationLibrary resource by ENV D's assembly tool.
* Masks: `game/assets/masks/mask_<name>.glb`. The MaskDef.model scene has its pivot at the face centre and −Z forward, and
  attaches to `Head`.

## v1.2 (QD-3, QB-51, D-038)
* Each BoneAttachment3D (`HandR`, `HandL`, `Head`, `Back`, `Hip`) has a child `Marker3D` named **`Socket`**
  carrying the attach offset, because a BoneAttachment3D's own transform is overwritten by the bone. Attach to
  `<Marker>/Socket`: the weapon at `HandR/Socket` (weapon X right, Y up, −Z muzzle), the mask at `Head/Socket` (face
  centre; MaskDef pivot seats there), loot bags at `Back/Socket`, and the pager/radio at `Hip/Socket`.
* Masks: ENV A attaches masks with ENV B's `MaskCatalog.resolve()/from_descriptor()` + `MaskComposer.instantiate()`
  (by class name). ENV A never builds mask visuals itself.
* Assembled character scenes keep their skinned meshes as binary `.res` beside the scene (~1.2 MB each,
  accepted; repo size watched per D-011).
* `world/characters/characters.json` is the index of assembled characters (id → scene path).

## v1.3: animation facts and first-person viewmodel (QD-5, D-041)

### Third-person animation facts (ENV D → ENV A)
* Clip speeds at 1.78 m (m/s): walk 1.6, run 3.5, sprint 5.75, crouch_walk 1.5, strafe 1.2, walk_back 1.3,
  flee 4.0, carry_bag_walk 2.4. Playback `speed_scale = v / clip_speed` (× `Skeleton3D.motion_scale` for other heights).
* `turn_l`/`turn_r`: ENV A yaws the root ±90° linearly over 0.8 s. `death_front` = face-down, `death_back` =
  onto the back (pick from the hit direction).
* Animation event frames (30 fps) are listed in `game/assets/characters/char_anim_humanoid/SOURCE.txt`
  (reload mag_out/mag_in/done, radio key_on/key_off, throw_bag release, melee hit, drill_place attach,
  death impact). ENV A syncs gameplay to them.
* Third-person weapon: the weapon origin (visual_slots firing-hand pivot) goes at `HandR/Socket` (18° grip rake);
  the support hand IKs to the weapon's `LeftHandIK`.

### First-person viewmodel (`rig_arms` = `char_arms_fp`)
* `root` = camera origin, −Z forward; arm/finger bones use the humanoid contract names. Helper bones: `weapon`
  (child of `hand.R` at the grip offset, weapon axes; ENV A attaches the WeaponVisual via a BoneAttachment3D
  on it) and `magazine` (child of `weapon`, identity when seated, animated during reloads).
* One AnimationLibrary per `WeaponDef.anim_set` (`pistol`, `smg`, `rifle`, `shotgun`, `lmg`, `sniper`), played as
  `"<anim_set>/<clip>"`. Clips: `idle*`, `ads_idle*`, `draw`, `holster`, `fire`, `fire_ads`, `reload`, `reload_empty`,
  `sprint*`, plus `reload_start` / `reload_loop` / `reload_end` (shell-by-shell sets) and `bolt` (sniper).
* Reload event frames (mag_out, mag_swap, mag_in, slide_release, done) are in the clip set's SOURCE.txt.
  ENV A drives the weapon model's `Slide` / `Pump` / `Bolt` nodes from those events.

## v1.4: per-set viewmodel details (D-044)
* **Shotgun:** the pump action is part of `fire`/`fire_ads` (PD2). Shell-by-shell = `reload_start` + n × `reload_loop`
  (looped, one shell, shell_in@8) + `reload_end`, or `reload_end_empty` (adds a pump). `reload`/`reload_empty` are pre-composed
  for 6 rounds. Matching data: reload_start_s 0.4, reload_per_round_s 0.4333, reload_end_s 0.4 (1.2 empty).
* **Sniper:** a separate `bolt` / `bolt_ads` clip (27 frames) plays after each shot (9 + 27 frames = 1.2 s ≈ 50 rpm).
* **Full-auto** fire clips are 3 frames and restart every shot.
* `rig_arms` `weapon` bone: identity under hand.R except during `sniper_bolt*` and `sniper_reload_empty` (the left hand holds the gun).
* Part travel for ENV A: pump 0.075 m; bolt lift 62° + 0.075 m; LMG feed cover 78°. Weapon models with a hinged feed cover
  expose `FeedCover` (pivot at the rear hinge, rotating about local X) (visual_slots.md).

## v1.5: batch-2/3 viewmodel sets (D-053, D-058)
* Sets: `akimbo`, `revolver`, `break_action`, `lever`, `bow`, `crossbow`, `launcher`, `flamethrower`, `saw`, `minigun`,
  `shotgun_box` (box/drum-fed shotguns Harrow/Brute; D-058), plus pistol `fire_auto`/`fire_auto_ads` (3 f).
* Loop naming: Godot strips a `_loop` suffix only when the short name is free, so hold loops are named `fire_hold`
  (flamethrower, minigun) and `cut_hold` (saw); the lever keeps `reload_loop`. Every clip imports exactly as named.
* Shell-fed sets (shotgun, lever) always use the shell pieces (D-053). Lever `fire` includes the lever cycle
  (lever_open/lever_close events).
* Bow: held in hand.L; the `weapon` bone carries the bow (origin = riser grip, Y = arrow, Z = up the riser) at
  hand.L × `fp.offhand_grip`. The arrow rides the `magazine` bone (drawn back 0.40 m × draw, hidden at release).
  SOURCE `curve.bow_<clip>: draw=…` gives per-frame draw (0 brace … 1 full); ENV A bends StringUpper/Lower so the nock
  sits 0.155 + 0.40 × draw m behind the grip (brace 0.155 since v1.7, matching ENV B's Thorn). `fire` = release, `reload` = nock; `draw_string`'s last frame = `hold` frame 0.
* The `weapon` bone moves relative to hand.R during the lever cycle and every bow clip (SOURCE `weapon_bone` lists them).
* Weapon-model layout assumed by the choreography: break-action hinge forward of and below the breech face; lever
  loading gate on the right; saw blade + side grip on the left; minigun left side grip and ammo box on the left.
* Bulwark `shield_idle*` (humanoid, 3.6 s, speed 0) blends seamlessly with `shield_walk` frame 0.

## v1.6: faction variants (QA-29, D-067)
* A variant scene is `res://world/characters/<id>_<variant>/<id>_<variant>.tscn`, with variant = `frd` | `sentinel` | `zero`;
  `tac` or empty = the base `<id>`. Shields are at `world/characters/bulwark_<v>/bulwark_<v>_shield.tscn`.
* characters.json entries carry `variant_of` + `variant`. The helper is `variant_scene_path(char_id, variant)` in
  `world/characters/_tools/character_spec.gd`. ENV A resolves EnemyDef visuals per faction (EnemyDef `params.visual_variant`).
* Special colours (Stinger blue, medic white, Phantom lenses, hazard yellow) and every contract node are identical in
  every variant. Brandt/Aegis have no variants.

## v1.7: non-gun first-person sets, gun bash, NPC ambient clips (D-069)
* **FP sets for items** (AnimationLibrary named by the item def's `anim_set`, see data contracts):
  * melee: `melee_knife`, `melee_blunt`, `melee_blade` with `idle*`, `sprint*`, `draw`, `holster`, `swing`
    (hit@ event), `charge_start`, `charge*`, `charge_swing` (hit@). `charge_start` lasts `MeleeDef.charge_time_s`.
  * throwable: `throwable` with `draw` (pin_pull@; ENV A hides the item's `Pin` there), `throw`, `throw_low` (release@).
  * deployables: `deploy_bag`, `deploy_small`, `deploy_sentry` with `place` (place@ = `DeployableDef.deploy_time_s`).
* **Gun bash:** every gun set has `<set>_bash` with a `hit@` event (PD2 weapon butt).
* Items ride the `weapon` bone in item clips (it is not identity under hand.R there); see visual_slots.md "Items".
* **Viewmodel camera near plane 0.02 m** (the 0.05 default cuts shouldered stocks in ADS). ENV A sets it on the crew
  Camera3D in first person.
* **Left hand:** ENV A IKs the FP left hand to the equipped weapon model's `LeftHandIK` at runtime; guns sharing a set
  differ by up to 0.24 m, so the clip's left hand is only a default.
* **NPC ambient clips** (humanoid, all loops, speed 0 unless noted): `desk_work` 12 s, `phone_seated` 8 s,
  `phone_call` 4 s, `sit_chair_watch` 10 s, `mug_idle` 8 s (sip@105), `mug_carry_walk` 1.13 s (1.3 m/s), `mop` 4 s,
  `sit_bed_read` 10 s (page_turn@221; root on the mattress top), `idle_thug` 3.5 s (cartel; long gun held low,
  left hand off LeftHandIK). Seat, bed and prop grip placement is in char_anim_humanoid/SOURCE.txt.

## v1.8: heister FP sleeves (D2-03, D-070)
* `char_arms_fp_<heister>` (rook, sable, dutch, wren) at `res://assets/characters/char_arms_fp_<heister>/char_arms_fp_<heister>.glb`:
  a mesh-only sleeve variant of `char_arms_fp` with `<root>/rig_arms/Skeleton3D/Arms` (a skinned MeshInstance3D) and no
  AnimationPlayer; its rig_arms bones, order, rests and bind poses equal `char_arms_fp`'s.
* ENV A's FpViewmodel instances the variant for the local player's heister, copies its `Arms` `mesh` and `skin` onto
  `char_arms_fp`'s `Arms`, then frees the variant. Clips stay in `char_arms_fp`. No variant (generic crew or unknown
  heister) = `char_arms_fp`'s own suit sleeves. Gloved hands use the glove material (no skin under the glove).
* Humanoid `rappel` clip (ENV D, for A's QC-41 NpcMotor rappel descent): 30 f loop (1 s per hop), 2.5 m/s straight down
  (A's rappel speed defaults to this ◇), event `land@0`; rope at x 0, z −0.24 in root space, wall contact at z −0.80
  (play it without a wall for skylight drops). Details: SOURCE `rappel_rope`.
* **Masks clear the crew face envelope** (D-073): crew masks are built to clear the crew face envelope
  (`tools/blender/masks/_crew_face_envelope.json`, a cylindrical height map of every crew head + hair at Head/Socket)
  by ≥ 3 mm. A crew head change regenerates the envelope and rebuilds the masks; a staleness test guards it.

## v1.10: locomotion blend set, reactions, deaths (D3-04, D-076)
* 8-way: `walk_fl/fr/l/r/bl/br/b` (30 f, 1.6 m/s), `run_fl/fr/l/r/bl/br/b` (21 f, 3.5 m/s), phase-locked to `walk`/`run`
  (right foot down at t=0, left at 0.5); SOURCE `dir_deg` clockwise from forward. `strafe_l/r`, `walk_back` stay.
* Starts/stops: `walk_start`, `walk_stop`, `run_start`, `run_stop`. A start begins on idle frame 0 and ends exactly on walk
  frame 3 / run frame 4 (no crossfade); a stop begins on cycle frame 0 and ends on idle frame 0. Root motion in SOURCE
  `curve.<clip>` (0.52 / 0.44 / 1.32 / 0.90 m).
* Hit reacts: `hit_react` (front), `hit_react_back` / `_left` / `_right`: pick by bullet travel direction d in the body
  frame (d.z > 0.5 front, < −0.5 back, d.x > 0.5 left, else right).
* Deaths: `death_front_b` (knees@16, impact@38), `death_back_b` (ends 1.0–1.9 m behind the root), `death_side` (impact@36).
* `downed_crawl` (60 f loop, 0.3 m/s; NPC / bleed-out drag; PD2 players do not crawl). `dozer_walk_heavy` (1.7 m/s,
  step_r@0 step_l@16; Wrecker via `params.anim_walk_clip`, clip_speeds 1.7).
* Recommended blend (ENV A): two BlendSpace2D (walk, run) with the 8 directions, sync on,
  speed_scale = v / (1.6 or 3.5 × motion_scale), crossfade walk↔run at the existing split (SOURCE `locomotion_blend`).

## v1.12: ragdoll (PO6-19, D-114 §7)
Every character scene has `Skeleton3D/Ragdoll`, a
`PhysicalBoneSimulator3D` shipped with `active = false`, holding `PhysicalBone3D` bodies `Hips`, `Spine`,
`Chest`, `Head`, `UpperArmL/R`, `ForearmL/R`, `ThighL/R`, `ShinL/R` (`bone_name` = the contract bone; each
with a `Shape` child; ~80 kg total; cone joints at the spine, neck, shoulders and hips, hinge joints
flexing the elbows forward and the knees back, 0–140°). Bodies are on physics layer 11 `ragdoll` and
collide with `world_static | world_dynamic | ragdoll` only (not players, NPCs or hitboxes). ENV A starts it at death with `active = true` +
`physical_bones_start_simulation()`, applies impulses to the body of the hit bone (nearest ancestor with
a body), and freezes the corpse after ~3 s by baking the bodies into the bone poses and stopping the
simulation (recipe: `world/characters/_tools/RAGDOLL.md`). project.godot names `3d_physics/layer_11="ragdoll"`.

## v1.13: pose-aware deaths (PO6-18, D-114 §7)
Five death clips that start exactly on their source pose's frame and end on the floor; root fixed; hips and head
never rise more than 5 cm above their start height (SOURCE `pose_deaths`):
* `death_crouch` (45 f, impact@26): from `crouch_idle` f0; topples onto the left side.
* `death_kneel_cuffed` (45 f, impact@24): from `kneel_cuffed` f0; pitches forward face-down, wrists stay together behind the back.
* `death_kneel` (45 f, impact@24): from `surrender`'s last frame (kneeling, hands on head); hands slide off, same fall.
* `death_prone` (30 f, impact@3): from `lie_down` f0; goes limp in place.
* `death_downed` (36 f, impact@20): from `downed` f0; falls back flat.
ENV A mapping (`AnimTweak.death_by_pose`): crouch_idle / crouch_walk / cower → death_crouch; kneel_cuffed / tied →
death_kneel_cuffed; surrender → death_kneel; lie_down → death_prone; downed / downed_crawl → death_downed. A rig without
the clip freezes the pose and topples (A's fallback); strong impulses still ragdoll (v1.12).

## v1.14: scripted clip override (PO6-17, D-114 §5)
`AnimDriver.META_ANIM_OVERRIDE` = NPC meta `&"anim_override"`, value a **StringName clip** name. While set (non-empty) on a
living NPC it wins over every NPC state and brain hint (only stun/tased is checked first); `&""` or removing the meta clears
it, and the normal state/hint/locomotion selection resumes (then the `rappel` loop while `NpcMotor.rappelling`). Set and
cleared on the **host** only by ENV A's assault events: AssaultEventRunner `_set_anim` on guided legs (`rappel_hang`,
`rappel_descend`, `rappel_land`, `van_exit`, `breach_place`, `breach_standback`; cleared when the leg ends / the unit is
released) and AssaultHeli for the sniper on the seat (`heli_door_idle` / `heli_door_aim` by its laser). Missing clips fall
back via `AnimDriver.FALLBACK_CLIPS` (rappel_* → climb_ladder / idle_alert, heli_door_* → aim_rifle, van_exit → walk,
breach_place → interact_mid, breach_standback → crouch_idle). The meta is host-side and not replicated (metas do not sync); a
client-side mirror of the scripted clip is a follow-up if PO playtests need it.
